notablePrerequisites: Arcbound Worker has at least one counter on it.
description:
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Arcbound Worker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Acrbound Worker, adding {C}{C}.
Arcbound Worker dies, triggering its modular ability and Together Forever.
Resolve the Arcbound Worker trigger, moving its +1/+1 counters onto another artifact creature.
Resolve the Together Forever trigger, returning Arcbound Worker from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Arcbound Worker by paying {1}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
